definitions.gloss: dim sum; yum cha; Chinese tea-accompanied small dishes
definitions.explanation: The Cantonese tradition of eating small steamed and fried dishes while drinking tea. In Japanese, the word refers both to the custom and to the dishes themselves.

examples.japanese: {飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go out for dim sum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦{中華街|ちゅうかがい}→中華街：11353_chuukagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed dim sum in Yokohama's Chinatown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧な⟦{点心|てんしん}→点心：13426_tenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: On the weekend, our family went to a dim sum restaurant and ordered various dumplings and appetizers.

notes:
A loanword from Cantonese ({飲茶|やむちゃ}, yám chàh), literally meaning 'drink tea.' Refers to the Chinese custom of eating small dishes (⟦{点心|てんしん}→点心：13426_tenshin⟧) accompanied by tea, or to the dishes and dining experience itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat dim sum
- {飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: dim sum restaurant
- {飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: dim sum cuisine
- {飲茶|やむちゃ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: dim sum set (meal)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{点心|てんしん}→点心：13426_tenshin⟧: dim sum dishes; Chinese snacks/appetizers — refers to the individual dishes rather than the dining custom
- ⟦{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}→中華料理：18122_chuukaryouri⟧: Chinese cuisine — the broader category
- ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧: gyoza, dumplings — one of the most common dim sum items known in Japan

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dim sum is popular in Japan, especially in Chinatown areas like ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦{中華街|ちゅうかがい}→中華街：11353_chuukagai⟧ and ⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧{南京町|なんきんまち}. Common items include {小籠包|しょうろんぽう} (soup dumplings), ⟦{焼売|しゅうまい}→焼売：13489_shuumai⟧ (siu mai), and ⟦{春巻|はるま}き→春巻き：28818_harumaki⟧ (spring rolls).
